Maria G.: Heads-up — APAC dedicated invoice looks off. Proration on reserved commits plus burst shows duplicated token attribution across two nodepools for the same customer. attaching invoice link: https://invoices.redwood/inv_5598.pdf :mag:
Samir C.: Can you paste the offending line items or a short CSV snippet? which period is this for?
Maria G.: Period 2026-02-25 → 2026-03-24. Here's the condensed CSV export from billing repro: ```line_item_id,description,region,committed_units,used_units,burst_units,amount
L1001,Reserved commit - apac-region-1,apac,100000,95000,0,5000.00
L1002,Burst usage - apac-region-1,apac,100000,15000,15000,750.00
L1003,Burst usage - apac-region-2,apac,0,15000,15000,750.00
L1004,Reserved commit - apac-region-2,apac,50000,48000,0,2500.00
``` The problem: the 15k burst looks counted against both region-1 and region-2 even though tokens originated in region-1. So customer is seeing ~1500 USD duplicated burst charge.
Olivia K.: Sounds like a nodepool tag attribution mismatch. Did failover or live-migration occur during that window?
devops-bot: Failover event detected for customer cust-814 on 2026-03-10T03:12:34Z. Traffic shifted from apac-region-1 to apac-region-2 for 1h 42m. Logs: /logs/cust-814/failover/2026-03-10.log
Maria G.: That explains the routing — but billing should attribute tokens to the origin pool, not both. Need reconciliation: either credit duplicated burst lines or re-tag usage. @Samir C. can you advise on credit policy?
Samir C.: For duplicated billing we require: (1) evidence of duplicate token counts in same UTC window, (2) confirmation that both line items map to the same customer and resource, (3) SLA breach evidence if customer experienced degradation. If all 3 true, recommend refund the duplicated burst amount (full) + offer 10% goodwill credit on next invoice. Please prep case and JE code.
Maria G.: Uploaded proof bundle to billing case #BILL-2026-174. Added CSV, failover logs, and request to vendor for reclassification of L1003. Placing invoice INV-5598 on hold pending review (hold flag set until 2026-03-28).
Alex (Finance): Ack. If we proceed with credit, use JE code 4-010-BILL and memo "APAC duplicated burst credit — cust-814". Finance approves provisional credit up to $1,700 pending final vendor reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
Olivia K.: Product side: agree with customer goodwill. Also flagging for runtime: we should add an attribution marker at ingress so routed fallback doesn't create new billable tags. Filing infra ticket INFRA-882.
Samir C.: Next steps: (a) Devops to confirm token-level duplication window and export per-token hash counts, (b) Billing to request vendor reclassification + adjusted invoice, (c) Finance to prepare provisional JE and notify accounting. Target resolution: 2026-03-27.
devops-bot: Token-level export started. ETA 4h. Output saved to /exports/cust-814/token_hash_20260310.csv
Maria G.: I'll update the customer-facing thread after we have token confirmation. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Alex (Finance): Please include predicted credit amount in the case update once token export done.
Maria G.: Will do — tagging @Samir C. and @Alex (Finance) once we get the token file. Closing interim notes here.
